item.title: HR’s image problem exposed by a viral snowstorm
item.description: A series of satirical social media posts by the police department in Louisville, Ky., highlighted a truth many HR pros already know: Employees don’t like HR. But what is the real cost of that reputation? The post HR’s image problem exposed by a viral snowstorm appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: Why pharmacy transparency is becoming a C-suite issue
item.description: HR leaders need a clearer understanding of how pharmacy benefits actually work and what increasing calls for transparency could mean for their responsibilities going forward. The post Why pharmacy transparency is becoming a C-suite issue appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: How a Singapore energy giant is redefining talent to avoid ‘job hugging’
item.description: Joey Kwek of Senoko Energy argues that low turnover can mask stagnation, and she pushes HR to rethink what workforce resilience really means. The post How a Singapore energy giant is redefining talent to avoid ‘job hugging’ appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: Eightfold AI bias suit: Just the ‘tip of the iceberg’?
item.description: When orgs share proprietary data with their AI-powered vendors, the risk for legal scrutiny soars, this expert says. The post Eightfold AI bias suit: Just the ‘tip of the iceberg’? appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: Amazon’s layoff leak: What went wrong?
item.description: An accidental email alerted some employees to impending layoffs, as nerves were already high about job cuts at the tech giant. One expert shares why empathy and clarity need to be at the heart of any layoff communication. The post Amazon’s layoff leak: What went wrong? appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: UPS cuts 30,000 more jobs as Amazon pivot reshapes workforce strategy
item.description: UPS is cutting 30,000 jobs in 2026 through voluntary programs, following 48,000 cuts in 2025. The workforce strategy offers HR leaders a template for managing large-scale transitions without mass layoffs. The post UPS cuts 30,000 more jobs as Amazon pivot reshapes workforce strategy appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: 2026 DOL enforcement budgets: HR’s compliance and risk exposure
item.description: Despite political pressure, most DOL enforcement agencies saw minimal budget changes. OFCCP, WHD, OSHA funding levels and what they mean for compliance. The post 2026 DOL enforcement budgets: HR’s compliance and risk exposure appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: Pinterest layoffs: 15% workforce reduction to fund AI transformation
item.description: Pinterest announced layoffs affecting less than 15% of its workforce, framing the cuts as strategic reallocation to AI-focused roles. The move offers HR leaders a real-time case study in AI transformation workforce planning. The post Pinterest layoffs: 15% workforce reduction to fund AI transformation appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: Deepfakes in the talent pool: How AI is reshaping hiring
item.description: Deepfaking and identity fraud are chief among concerns when it comes to the use of AI in the hiring process, according to a recent survey. The post Deepfakes in the talent pool: How AI is reshaping hiring appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: Is AI eating your talent pipeline? Plus, breaking news
item.description: Gartner warns 30% of enterprises will face declining decision quality by 2030 as junior employees lose chances to build judgment skills. The post Is AI eating your talent pipeline? Plus, breaking news appeared first on HR Executive.
